source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis), keyless HTTP API
substitutes_for: ERA5-Land, which requires a Copernicus CDS API key we do not hold

point.derived_from: centroid of the supplied taluk polygon

resolution_caveat: MERRA-2 is ~0.5 deg x 0.625 deg (~55 x 70 km). The entire 437 km2 taluk falls in one or two cells, so this is a TALUK-scale series. Every parcel in a given month receives the same value; it carries no within-taluk spatial information.
units_note: t2m is degrees Celsius as POWER serves it; t2m_kelvin is the converted column Presto expects.
